thread:
Emily: Heads up — Shoreline Connect onboarding is hitting Canada region limits during their load test, customer asked for a short-term bump and an IP allowlist. Account is flagged for renewal risk; want to avoid churn. @Jamal can we do a temporary QPS bump + CIDR allowlist?
Jamal: Yup — how much bump are they asking for?
Emily: They asked to double QPS to 1200 QPS for the next 72h, then taper. Also need Canada egress pinned to ca-west-1 for latency.
Nora: We can route them to ca-west-1 but need to provision peering and add CIDR entries. Need CIDRs and contact IPs.
Emily: Sent their CIDR: 203.0.113.0/24 and 198.51.100.0/25. They want auto-revoke after 72h.
Jamal: Ok will add an ephemeral allowlist with TTL=72h and bump QPS on their account. I'll adjust rate window and put note in console. @Sandeep can you confirm there's capacity on the dedicated pool?
Sandeep: Checking capacity now — ca-west-1 has spare headroom for 72h, but we should set fallback to compatible model variant if nodes fill. I'll add canary routing and an overflow policy.
Jamal: Done in infra: applied temporary qps=1200, cidrs added, TTL=72h. deploy-bot: provisioned peering ca-west-1 -> applied routing policy shore_connect_1839990000.
Emily: Great. I'll update the renewal playbook — captured that we granted a time-limited boost and collected feedback on latency. Asking Product for a follow-up on long-term options (dedicated capacity or routing optimizations).
Nora: Also logged tickets: INF-8342 (allowlist), PEER-4401 (peering), CS-299 (renewal note).
Emily: Customer is happy for now. Follow-up: schedule 1:1 in 48h to confirm telemetry and to propose long-term dedicated capacity in renewal discussion.
Jamal: 👍 will monitor metrics and set alert for qps >90% of new cap and kv-cache warmup metric.
Emily: Thanks all :thumbsup:
